task: User-directed warm ochre and sepia UI palette
direction: Warm yellow ochre and parchment, with burnt sienna accents and burnt umber structure/ink. Retain the wooden Eastlake interface and engraved paper plates.
historicScope: An original game color direction requested by the user, not a measured historical paint specification or an assertion that nineteenth-century scenes were monochrome.

parchment.role: Printed controls, menu paper and diagnostic input surfaces

yellowOchre.role: Core hue and palette guide; warmer tonal variations in wood finish and plan

burntSienna.role: Accent family; restrained warm red-brown cues

burntUmber.role: Wood finish, boundaries, plan outlines and outer preview ground

umberInk.role: Paper text, loading screen ground and browser theme color

healthHoney.role: Health fill; numerical HP remains visible

lowHealthSienna.role: Low-health fill with existing numeric/state feedback

fireCopper.role: Ground-plan fire and key; dark umber outline preserves separation

disabledUmber.role: Readable inactive/empty/spent ink on parchment or a selected ochre plate

boundaries: CSS color/tint layers preserve the pinned wood texture and engraving/font bytes.
No canvas-wide sepia filter or material/gameplay recoloring is applied.
The UI workbench uses warm illustrative ground only; the world art team can use this guide for its own palette pass.
Controls, button order, input, timers, snapshots and automatic-pickup requirement are unchanged.
